summary: Full backend and frontend testing of ReverSound platform. All 17 backend tests pass. Frontend is fully functional with dark theme, Turkish language, working navigation, beats/gigs marketplace, auth flow, dashboard, admin portal, AI coach, and subscription pages.

issues: Admin wallet shows ₺0 (by design - admin seeded with 0 balance, no welcome bonus). May confuse if admin tests wallet features.

critical_code_review_comments: Message moderation: emails in messages are flagged but NOT blocked — messages are stored with content replaced by '[Message blocked by moderation]' but the API returns 200. This is by design (sanitized), but UI should show warning to user clearly.
Admin seed: `seed_admin` only creates admin if not exists or updates password if mismatch — correctly idempotent.
bcrypt: uses gensalt() (produces $2b$ prefix) — correct format.
httpOnly cookies: set on login with samesite=lax, secure=False. In production, secure should be True.
No brute force lockout implemented — after 5 failed logins the account is NOT locked. Security concern for production.

Token stored in localStorage as rs_token (mentioned in requirements) but looking at auth.py it only sets httpOnly cookies + returns in response body. Frontend localStorage storage needs to be verified.
server.py is 68 lines — well structured. No files over 700 lines.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data: 6 beats, 4 gigs. Test user created via registration API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows working. Backend 100% pass. Frontend dark theme, Turkish locale, all pages render correctly. Beat marketplace (6 beats), Gig marketplace (4 gigs), Auth (login/register), Dashboard, Admin portal, AI Coach (Gemini), Subscriptions all working. Escrow system tested (MOCKED). Message moderation: sanitizes emails (replaces content) but doesn't block with 400 - returns 200 with is_flagged=true. No brute force lockout implemented.
mocked_apis: /api/wallet/topup - mock payment, no real gateway (as documented)
